name: due-date-label
title: Due date label
description: A due date in words that matter: 'Due today', 'Due in 3 days' or 'Overdue by 2 days', with an icon that carries the urgency.
docs: Days are compared as calendar days in timeZone, so a task due today never reads overdue at 00:01. A date-only string like 2026-10-24 is a calendar date and never shifts. The full date is in a tooltip that opens on hover and on a tap; add focusable for a keyboard tab stop, or showDate to write it into the line (Due in 3 days · Fri 23 Oct) for phones and print. Pass now for tests; otherwise it reads the browser clock after hydration.
